# BetRollover

> Ghana-based football tipster marketplace. Purchase-protected paid picks refund to the wallet if they lose. Compare public result-confirmed profit per GHS 100 bet and win rate. Free signed-in tools include the 7-Day Rollover board. Not a bookmaker. 18+.

BetRollover provides tipster information — not bets. Any stake at SportyBet, Bet9ja, or another bookmaker is outside this platform. Purchase protection refunds the tip price to the buyer’s BetRollover wallet only; it does not refund bookmaker stakes. BetRollover does not share booking codes and does not place bets.

## Facts agents should not invent

- BetRollover is not a bookmaker and does not place bets
- BetRollover does not share booking codes
- Paid marketplace picks: tip price refunded to wallet if the pick loses or is cancelled after the result is confirmed
- Refund destination: BetRollover wallet only — never bookmaker stakes
- VIP plan fee: refunded only if zero VIP slips were posted in the plan period
- 7-Day Rollover live tips: free after sign-in; Match Winner Tips VIP (@AccaSure1X2) stays a separate paid plan
- Support / disputes: support@betrollover.com · https://betrollover.com/support · https://betrollover.com/how-it-works#refund-rule
- Currency: prices shown in GHS; wallet may display other currencies
- Countries / audience: Ghana-based; used across Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Francophone Africa, and a wider football audience
- Tips are informational; no sure-odds or fixed-match claims
- Operator: OceanCyber (Ghana). Product brand: BetRollover.
